accountView.followUpDraft:
Subject: Following up on my {{role}} application

Hi {{company}} team,

I applied for the {{role}} role{{when}} and remain very interested. I'd welcome any update on where the process stands — and I'm happy to provide anything further that would be useful.

Thank you for your time.
accountView.followUpCopied: Follow-up draft copied — paste it into your email.
accountView.followUpCopyFailed: Couldn't copy — select and copy manually.
accountView.seedMandateTip: Prefills the apply agent's search with these role titles. Nothing starts until you activate it there.
accountView.seedMandate: Have the agent hunt for jobs like these ({{titles}})
accountView.agentCanApplyTip: This employer's form is one the apply agent can fill and submit on its own. It still hands it back to you if the employer asks something we can't answer from your profile.
accountView.agentCanApply: The agent can apply to this one for you
accountView.ivhClosedAfter: This posting came down {{d}} days after your interview, and hasn't gone back up.
accountView.ivhRelistedAfter: This posting came down after your interview — but the same role has since gone back up.
accountView.ivhStillOpen: Still live on the company's own feed, {{d}} days after your interview.
accountView.ivhClosedBefore: We recorded this posting coming down before the interview date you saved — worth checking the date.
accountView.ivhSinceProvenance: From our own daily record of this exact posting on the company's careers feed. A posting coming down means the ad was withdrawn — it doesn't tell us who was hired.
accountView.fitCheckHourly: Hourly limit reached: you can check fit again within the hour.
accountView.trackerLoadFailed: We couldn't load your scans and applications. Nothing is lost.
accountView.deleteBillingSupport: Can't find it? Write to {{support}} from the address the plan is billed to.
accountView.passRetired: Agent Pass: retired before it could run. Write to {{support}} from the address you paid with and we will honour what you bought.
accountView.queueUncertain: Sent — but we could not confirm it
accountView.queueRetired: Not sent: the agent is switched off. Apply yourself from the link.
accountView.queueGivenBack: This application was given back to your pass.
accountView.profileUploadedAndRead: Saved. We filled in {{count}} details from your CV — check them below.
accountView.profileUploadedSaved: Saved. Your CV is attached and the agent can start.
accountView.agentProfileRetired: The apply agent is switched off, so nothing here is sent to any employer. These are the answers you stored for it. You can delete them, with your stored CV, below.
accountView.profileNothingStored: Nothing is stored for the agent.
accountView.deleteStoredStart: Delete my stored CV and answers
accountView.deleteStoredConfirmBody: This removes your stored CV file and every answer above. It cannot be undone.
accountView.deleteStoredDone: Deleted: your stored CV and answers are gone.
accountView.deleteStoredFailed: Could not delete them. Try again in a minute.
accountView.trackerLoadMoreFailed: Couldn't load your older applications. Try again.
accountView.digestSaveFailed: Couldn't save that change to your email alert, so it is back as it was. Try again.
